# book_asset (Resource)

The asset records of the service, through its state import and export



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) the record key, its identity in the service and in references
- `mime_type` (String) MIME type of the binary payload.
- `name` (String) Display name of the asset.

### Optional

- `banner_id` (String) The key of the asset record.
- `description` (String) Free form notes about the asset.
- `icon` (String) Icon name, url, or image asset id.
- `object_id` (String) Object the asset is attached to.
- `object_type` (String) Type of the object the asset is attached to.
- `owner_id` (String) Organisation that owns the asset. Defaults to the caller's user_claim owner when omitted.
- `type` (String) Asset role, image roles require an image mime type
